text.en:
Item (a), under "(22) Iloilo," paragraph (f), section two of Republic Act Numbered Fourteen hundred eleven, is amended to read as follows:
"(a)
1. Tigbauan Central School Home Economics Building, Repair ₱3,500.00
2. Tigbauan Central School Shop Building, Repair 3,500.00
3. Baroc Atabayan Seawall, Tigbauan 13,000.00
4. Jamog Rural Road, Tigbauan 20,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
